sentences.text: For Respondent(s) : Mr. Chandragupt Chopra, PP and Mr. Aditya Gaur for Complainant HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE ASHUTOSH KUMAR Order 20/01/2023
The present bail application has been filed under Section 439 Cr.P.C.

The petitioner has been arrested in connection with FIR No.485/2022 registered at Police Station Chhabra, District Baran for the offence under Section(s) 376, 376(2)(n) and 450 IPC and Section(s) 5(L)/6 & 5(J)(II) of POCSO Act.
It is contended by the learned counsel for the applicant- petitioner that marriage of the prosecutrix and applicant was fixed but due to some reasons it was not materialised.
Afterwards, due to some misunderstanding between the applicant and the prosecutrix the present FIR was lodged.

After lodging of the FIR again the matter has been settled between the families of the prosecutrix and the applicant and marriage of the prosecutrix and applicant was fixed for 26.12.2022 but due to not granting of the bail by the learned trial Court, the marriage was not solemnized.

] Father and mother of the prosecutrix have submitted their affidavit before the learned trial Court in which they have stated that marriage of their daughter and applicant Sharukh @ Shahrukh has been fixed and they do not want any legal action against applicant Sharukh, therefore, he should be enlarged on bail.
Learned Public Prosecutor has opposed the bail application.
Learned counsel for the complainant submits that the matter has amicably been settled between the parties.

Learned trial Court in its order dated 19.12.2022, rejecting the bail application of applicant Sharukh has mentioned this fact that marriage of prosecutrix and applicant was fixed, and on the date of the order preosecutrix and her parents were present in the Court.

sentences.text: Therefore, looking to the facts and circumstances of the case and keeping this fact in the mind that the prosecutrix and applicant are going to be married; but, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, this Court deems it just and proper to enlarge the applicant-petitioner on bail.

Accordingly, the bail application is allowed and it is directed that accused-petitioner Sharukh @
Shahrukh S/o Jabbar shall be released on bail under Section 439 Cr.P.C. in connection with afore-mentioned FIR registered at concerned Police Station, provided he furnishes a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) together with two sureties in the sum of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand only) each to the satisfaction of the trial Court with the stipulation that he shall (3 of 3) [CRLMB-40/2023] comply with all the conditions laid down under Section 437(3) Cr.P.C.
